potential_locations.clusterName: Madanapalle - Tamballapalle Mega Tomato Cold Hub
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Controlled Atmosphere (CA) Multi-Chamber with Hydro-cooling & Sorting lines
potential_locations.connectivity: Direct access to NH-71 & NH-42 corridor to Bengaluru & Chennai markets
potential_locations.rationale: Asia's largest tomato production belt experiences extreme price collapse during harvest gluts (prices dropping to Rs. 2-3/kg). Zero public CA cold storage within 25km radius causes up to 32% post-harvest spoilage.

potential_locations.clusterName: Podalakur - Rapur Acid Lime & Citrus Mega Preservation Hub
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Controlled Humidity (85-90%) & Degreening Multi-Chamber Facility
potential_locations.connectivity: State Highway connecting Nellore and Venkatagiri to NH-16 corridor
potential_locations.rationale: Podalakur and Rapur produce over 60% of Andhra Pradesh's acid lime. In summer months, skin yellowing and dehydration reduce export value by 45% within 48 hours of plucking without immediate cold staging.

potential_locations.clusterName: Adoni - Yemmiganur Multi-Commodity Cold Park
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Ventilated Precision Multi-Chamber (4-10°C) with Pre-cooling
potential_locations.connectivity: State Highway 24 connecting Adoni Industrial bypass and railway freight terminal
potential_locations.rationale: Western Kurnool produces over 140,000 MT of commercial fresh chillies and tomatoes. Severe deficit forces smallholders to sell at sub-optimal farmgate rates, resulting in up to 28% post-harvest decay.

potential_locations.clusterName: Mylavaram - Tiruvuru Mango Packhouse & CA Facility
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: APEDA-Certified CA Chambers with Vapour Heat Treatment (VHT) Line
potential_locations.connectivity: NH-30 linking Vijayawada and Bhadrachalam
potential_locations.rationale: Dense mango orchard belt in Krishna-NTR border produces Banganapalle and Totapuri varieties. Lack of local packhouse causes fruit fly vulnerability and loss of export premiums during April-June harvest window.

potential_locations.clusterName: Bangarupalem - Baireddipalle Mango & Pulp Buffer Facility
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Dual Pre-cooling and Deep Freeze Aseptic Pulp Buffer (-18°C)
potential_locations.connectivity: NH-69 Bangalore - Chennai Industrial Expressway corridor
potential_locations.rationale: Over 80 pulp manufacturing units in Chittoor district depend on smooth mango intake. Processing bottlenecks during peak arrivals cause open-air decay of up to 40,000 MT of high-grade Totapuri fruit.

potential_locations.clusterName: Prathipadu - Pedanandipadu Chilli & Turmeric Feeder Depot
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Automated Temperature & Low-Humidity Spice Preservation CA Chamber
potential_locations.connectivity: NH-16 linking Guntur and Chennai
potential_locations.rationale: Southern Guntur black cotton soil produces high-oleoresin Teja chilli. Central Guntur cold stores reach 98% occupancy by March, leaving small and marginal farmers with no storage options.

potential_locations.clusterName: Banaganapalle - Owk Mango & Turmeric Preservation Terminal
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Combined CA Fruit Cell (10-12°C) and Spice Preservation Chamber (4-8°C)
potential_locations.connectivity: SH-30 connecting Banaganapalle with Tadipatri and Nandyal
potential_locations.rationale: The geographical origin of the GI-tagged 'Banaganapalle Mango' lacks cold storage at the mandal level. Farmers must transport sensitive produce 40 km to Nandyal town, suffering quality degradation.

potential_locations.clusterName: Vinukonda - Macherla High-Grade Fresh Chilli & Vegetable Facility
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Dual Temperature Cold Chambers (4-8°C and 8-12°C)
potential_locations.connectivity: NH-544D linking Guntur, Nandyal and Anantapur
potential_locations.rationale: Western Palnadu farmers travel 60+ km to Guntur city to find cold storage for fresh chillies and vegetables, causing high transport costs and deterioration during transit. A local facility will serve 45+ villages directly.

potential_locations.clusterName: Kadiri - Gandlapenta Sweet Orange & Pomegranate Center
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Controlled Humidity Semi-Arid Horticulture Chilling Chambers
potential_locations.connectivity: NH-42 connecting Madanapalle, Kadiri and Anantapur
potential_locations.rationale: Drought-prone Kadiri basin has expanded drip-irrigated citrus and pomegranate cultivation. High daytime heat (38-42°C) causes rapid rind desiccations and fungal fruit rot without immediate post-harvest chilling.

potential_locations.clusterName: Chintapalle - G.K.Veedhi Tribal Agency Spices & Ginger Depot
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Solar-Hybrid Micro Cold Chain with Low-Moisture Storage
potential_locations.connectivity: Ghat Road SH-38 linking Chintapalle, Narsipatnam and Anakapalli
potential_locations.rationale: High-altitude tribal farmers harvest high-curcumin organic turmeric and ginger. Lack of localized cold storage forces reliance on exploitative middlemen and causes weight losses of over 22% during open transport.

potential_locations.clusterName: Uravakonda - Beluguppa Sweet Orange (Mosambi) Cold Hub
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Multi-Chamber with Controlled Humidity & Fungicide Post-Harvest Wash
potential_locations.connectivity: NH-67 linking Bellary and Anantapur
potential_locations.rationale: Sweet orange growers suffer heavy skin shriveling and decay in semi-arid Rayalaseema heat without immediate pre-cooling and cold storage within 2 hours of harvest.

potential_locations.clusterName: Korukonda - Gokavaram Godavari Basin Banana & Cocoa Cold Depot
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Refrigerated Transit Dock with Controlled Humidity Cocoa Pod Holding
potential_locations.connectivity: SH-41 connecting Rajahmundry, Gokavaram and Rampachodavaram
potential_locations.rationale: Fertile alluvial tracts along the Godavari river cultivate Cavendish bananas and cocoa as intercrop. High tropical humidity triggers rapid anthracnose and stem-end rot unless chilled to 13°C within 4 hours.

potential_locations.clusterName: Addanki - Santhanuthalapadu Chilli & Vegetable Cold Terminal
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Dual Multi-Commodity Chamber with Forced-Air Cooling
potential_locations.connectivity: State Highway linking Addanki with Ongole and Chilakaluripet
potential_locations.rationale: Located at the tri-border of Bapatla, Prakasam and Palnadu. Addanki produces high volumes of green chillies and vegetables for Vijayawada and Chennai wholesale markets.

potential_locations.clusterName: Palakonda - Veeraghattam Tribal Agro & Cashew Processing Depot
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: De-humidified Raw Cashew Nut Storage and Pre-cooling Unit
potential_locations.connectivity: SH-2 linking Parvathipuram, Palakonda and Srikakulam
potential_locations.rationale: Northern tribal belt produces pesticide-free organic cashew and mangoes. Farmers lose up to 30% of nut quality to seasonal monsoon mould during prolonged storage without controlled humidity.

potential_locations.clusterName: Jammalamadugu - Mylavaram Banana & Papaya Packhouse
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Refrigerated Transit Pre-cooling & Ripening Facility (13-15°C)
potential_locations.connectivity: SH-28 connecting Proddatur, Tadipatri and Bellary
potential_locations.rationale: Penna river basin produces export-grade Grand Naine bananas, but lack of pre-cooling facilities forces farmers to sell at field gates at sub-optimal prices.

potential_locations.clusterName: Giddalur - Cumbum Semi-Arid Chilli & Tomato Center
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Multi-Chamber Produce Chilling Unit (4°C to 10°C)
potential_locations.connectivity: State Highway connecting Giddalur with Nandyal and Ongole
potential_locations.rationale: Western Nallamala foothill tract suffers severe post-harvest tomato gluts. Establishing a localized facility reduces transport distance from 110km to less than 15km for 30+ villages.

potential_locations.clusterName: Tekkali - Sompeta Coastal Cashew & Fruit Cold Station
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: De-humidified Low Temperature Cashew & Fruit Storage Cell
potential_locations.connectivity: NH-16 Chennai - Kolkata Golden Quadrilateral
potential_locations.rationale: Northern coastal belt of Srikakulam handles substantial cashew harvests and Banganapalle mangoes. Extreme coastal humidity damages raw cashew shells and causes premature mango softening without cold chain.

potential_locations.clusterName: Avanigadda - Nagayalanka Coastal Banana & Guava Depot
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Banana Controlled Ripening & Chilling Chambers (12-14°C)
potential_locations.connectivity: NH-216 Coastal Highway connecting Machilipatnam, Avanigadda and Ongole
potential_locations.rationale: Krishna river island farmers produce heavy yields of Karpura and Grand Naine bananas. Lack of cold chain on the delta bank forces farmers to sell at distress rates during cyclone threats and heavy rain gluts.

potential_locations.clusterName: Razole - Sakhinetipalli River Island Banana & Produce Terminal
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Ethylene Scrubbed Pre-cooling & Ripening Facility
potential_locations.connectivity: NH-216 and inland waterway barge connectivity
potential_locations.rationale: Konaseema island belt is encircled by Godavari distributaries. Ferry bottlenecks delay transit to mainland cold stores, triggering transit decay of up to 25% for ripe banana bunches.

potential_locations.clusterName: Venkatagiri - Dakkili Citrus, Lime & Horticultural Hub
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Controlled Temperature & Waxing Post-Harvest Unit (7-10°C)
potential_locations.connectivity: State Highway 61 linking Venkatagiri, Gudur and Tirupati
potential_locations.rationale: Acid lime growers in Venkatagiri valley face high spoilage in dry Rayalaseema heat. Cold holding facilities will allow orderly marketing into Chennai and Tirupati pilgrim markets.

potential_locations.clusterName: Gajapathinagaram - Badangi Mango & Cashew Cold Facility
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Pre-cooling & Palletized Multi-Commodity Cold Store
potential_locations.connectivity: NH-26 linking Vizianagaram, Bobbili and Raipur
potential_locations.rationale: Major Suvarnarekha and Banganapalle mango production tract. Cold staging prevents skin blotching and extends shelf life by 3 weeks, enabling sales to northern state markets via rail corridors.

potential_locations.clusterName: Pithapuram - Gollaprolu Cashew & Tropical Fruit Cold Station
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: De-humidified Raw Nut Cell and Fruit Cold Chamber
potential_locations.connectivity: NH-16 and Kakinada Port feeder road
potential_locations.rationale: Pithapuram cashew and mango farms experience high post-harvest losses during early monsoons. Direct cold staging supports value addition for local women self-help group processing clusters.

potential_locations.clusterName: Bheemunipatnam - Tagarapuvalasa Urban Periphery Vegetable Cold Hub
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Urban Consumer Supply Pre-cooling & Multi-Chamber (2-6°C)
potential_locations.connectivity: Visakhapatnam - Bheemunipatnam Coastal Beach Corridor & NH-16
potential_locations.rationale: Serves as the vital perishable supply buffer for the Visakhapatnam metropolitan area (pop. 2.4 million). Cushions mid-day heat wilting for local peri-urban farmers.

potential_locations.clusterName: Chodavaram - K.Kotapadu Organic Produce & Vegetable Center
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Solar-Assisted Micro Cold Storage Hub with Pre-cooling
potential_locations.connectivity: State Highway 9 connecting Anakapalli & Paderu tribal agency tracts
potential_locations.rationale: Direct supply line for Visakhapatnam urban consumption zone. Prevents mid-day wilting and spoilage for smallholder vegetable and fruit growers.

potential_locations.clusterName: Narasapuram - Palakollu Coastal Guava & Horticulture Packhouse
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Pre-cooling and Controlled Temperature Storage (8-12°C)
potential_locations.connectivity: NH-216 Coastal Highway
potential_locations.rationale: Vast guava orchards in Palakollu and Mogalthur produce high-yield Allahabad Safeda and Taiwan varieties. Guavas soften rapidly within 36 hours of plucking in coastal heat without pre-cooling.

potential_locations.clusterName: Chintalapudi - Kamavarapukota Inland Agro Buffer Station
potential_locations.recommendedChamberType: Multi-Commodity Pre-cooling & Humidity Regulated Cell
potential_locations.connectivity: SH-42 connecting Jangareddigudem and Chintalapudi to Vijayawada
potential_locations.rationale: Inland red-loam belt produces high volumes of cocoa pods and mangoes. Farmers face high freight costs to Eluru city, leading to on-farm degradation during peak summer heat.
